title: Tobacco Road Zimbabwe — EN/SN/PT (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona Portuguese heritage farm history tobacco
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The tobacco road ran from the barn down to the lower gate
Where the trucks came in the harvest season early and late
The leaves were hung in rows to dry in long amber patience
The smell of curing tobacco is the smell of those locations

[Verse 2 — Shona, with English translation]
Mugwagwa wfodya wakaenda kubva mutsaga kusvika kugeto
[The tobacco road ran from the barn to the gate]
MaTiraka akauya pakuvhara fodya nguva ye harvest
[The trucks came at tobacco harvest time]
Mashizha akasungirwa kuitira anyorore mukuoma
[The leaves were hung to dry slowly]
Hwema hwefodya yokuoma ndiyo hwema yenzvimbo idzi
[The smell of curing tobacco is the smell of those places]

[Chorus — English]
Tobacco road, tobacco road
Running through the memory of everything we had and owed
Tobacco road, tobacco road
The crop that fed the family in the season's heavy load
Tobacco road knows what the land was asked to give
Tobacco road knows what we gave it back to live

[Bridge — Portuguese, with English translation]
A estrada do tabaco corria do celeiro até ao portão
[The tobacco road ran from the barn to the gate]
Os caminhões chegavam na época da colheita com dedicação
[The trucks came at harvest time with dedication]
As folhas secavam penduradas em paciência dourada
[The leaves dried hanging in golden patience]
O cheiro do tabaco a curar é o cheiro daquela madrugada
[The smell of curing tobacco is the smell of that dawn]

[Outro — All three languages]
Tobacco road knows… Mugwagwa wefodya unoziva… A estrada do tabaco sabe
The land remembers — Nyika inoyeuka — A terra lembra
The gardens still growing
